digest.component_or_area: documentation: plan-review gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and author guide
propositions: Four reader-facing documentation locations currently lack a complete, consistent contract for the tri-state file-impact model (undeclared, paths, none)

The authoritative implementation semantics and replacement/clearing rules for file-impact states must be documented at plan-review-gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and public author guide consistently

Public CLI command rebar explain plan must communicate the tri-state choices, the none command syntax, the no-file-impact advisory LLM criterion, and reason requirements without internal source inspection
Standalone documentation must be verified through a durable semantic checklist with path:line evidence rather than source-text grep or snapshot tests

The test_explain_plan_file_impact_tristate_contract must assert public behavior contract (CLI markers present) without reading documentation source, inspecting private shape, or depending on text layout
